A precise, photo-realistic 3D character reference sheet. Use the uploaded image [上传图片的链接] as the sole reference for character identity, specific clothing, hair, tattoos, and textures. The character is posed on a seamless, flat-grey studio background. The images are arranged in a clean grid with even studio lighting and consistent scale. The reference sheet must contain only the following 8 frames in the specified layout:

Row 1: Full-Body Views

Frame 1: Full Front. The entire figure standing directly facing the camera, showing the complete front of all clothing and all frontal details.

Frame 2: Full Side. The entire figure in a clean profile view (right side), showing the side contours of the clothing and footwear.

Frame 3: Full Back. The entire figure standing directly facing away from the camera, showing the complete back of all clothing and footwear.

Frame 4: Full 45-Degree Front. A full-length, three-quarter front view (angled towards the left) to show the depth and specific three-dimensional form of the figure.

Row 2: Head and Shoulder Views

Frame 5: Head Front. A direct, clean portrait-style close-up portrait, focusing on the frontal details of the face and hair.

Frame 6: Head Side. A precise close-up profile portrait (right side), showing the side structure of the head and face.

Frame 7: Head Back. A close-up portrait from directly behind the head, focusing on the hair details from the back.

Frame 8: Head 45-Degree Front. A close-up three-quarter front portrait (angled towards the left) to show the three-dimensional facial structure and head form.

Constraints: Maintain exact character identity across all frames. Neutral expression for all frames unless the input image specifies otherwise. No overlapping of figures. High-resolution textures.
